description: Check whether AI agents receive the same page a browser does. Fetches the page as a browser and as ChatGPT-User, GPTBot, PerplexityBot and ClaudeBot (each with its published user agent) and reports per agent the HTTP status, whether it was blocked or challenged (401/403/429, a bot-check page, a robots.txt disallow), the words it received, how much of the browser's text that is, and whether the content only appears after JavaScript runs, with a verdict and a prioritized fix list. The requests come from SEO Score API's server, not the AI companies, so a block is a strong signal to confirm in the site's logs, not proof. Paid plans; counts as one audit; a page a browser can't load is not counted.

url.description: Full page URL including the protocol, e.g. https://example.com/pricing.

name: agent_view

agents.description: One row per agent: status, access, blocked, block_reason, robots_txt, word_count, parity.text_pct, js_dependent, findings.

notes.description: What the check does and does not establish.

priorities.description: Prioritized fixes, most important first. Each has the issue, the agents it applies to, a plain_english explanation and who_fixes_it.

verdict.description: status (pass, warning, fail) and a one-line summary.

title: AI Agent View
